h1: Engelberg ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Engelberg sits at 1,015 metres under the Titlis, and the ski area runs from the summit station at over 3,000 metres right down to the village - 82 kilometres of pistes and more than two dozen blue, red and black runs along the way. Among them are the Ice Flyer, the Marco-Odermatt Rotegg downhill route and the Truebsee descent into the valley, and the operator calls it the most snow-sure ski resort in Central Switzerland.
stayOverview: The village sits in a closed valley at the foot of the mountain, with the Titlis cable cars and the Brunni lifts on opposite sides of it. The monastery and the main street are a short walk from both.
hotelIntro: Book against high season. Engelberg is compact enough that most of the village is within walking distance of a lift.
rentalCars: Engelberg is at the end of its valley, 45 minutes from Lucerne by the Zentralbahn railway.
